# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# docs - API documentation generated by Doxygen from the public headers
#
#   cmake -S . -B build -DWHILE_IT_LASTS_BUILD_DOCS=ON
#   cmake --build build --target docs        # -> build/docs/html/index.html
#
# The guides themselves are in this folder: BUILDING.md, DATA-FORMAT.md,
# DECISIONS.md and ARCHITECTURE.html.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

find_package(Doxygen)

if(NOT DOXYGEN_FOUND)
    message(WARNING "Doxygen not found: the 'docs' target is not available")
    return()
endif()

set(DOXYGEN_PROJECT_NAME "${PROJECT_NAME}")
set(DOXYGEN_PROJECT_NUMBER "${PROJECT_VERSION}")
set(DOXYGEN_PROJECT_BRIEF "${PROJECT_DESCRIPTION}")
set(DOXYGEN_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
set(DOXYGEN_USE_MDFILE_AS_MAINPAGE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/README.md")
set(DOXYGEN_STRIP_FROM_PATH "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set(DOXYGEN_STRIP_FROM_INC_PATH "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
set(DOXYGEN_GENERATE_HTML YES)
set(DOXYGEN_EXTRACT_ALL YES)

doxygen_add_docs(
    docs
    "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
    "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/README.md"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/BUILDING.md"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/DATA-FORMAT.md"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/DECISIONS.md"
    COMMENT "Generating the While It Lasts API documentation"
)

if(WHILE_IT_LASTS_INSTALL)
    install(
        DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/html/"
        DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DOCDIR}"
        OPTIONAL
    )
endif()
